scope: 117 endpoint/action capabilities from the existing desktop/mobile/research applications, plus supplemental state-field observations. This is an implementation migration review, not a claim that all production flows passed.

statusDefinitions.native_form: Reachable native route, control, endpoint and payload reviewed statically.
statusDefinitions.advanced_input: Preserved through an explicit file/JSON evidence input in a native workbench; not a fully field-by-field wizard.
statusDefinitions.consolidated: Equivalent business behavior intentionally reads or uses a shared current endpoint; original transport is not called.
statusDefinitions.implemented_unwired: Implementation exists but no product-route import/append was present at review time.
statusDefinitions.not_implemented: No native replacement action was present at review time.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some original behavior or data access remains unavailable.

runtimeEvidence.targetedResult: 11 tests passed: pure evidence/parser rules and controlled DOM/mock imports. This does not exercise 117 live endpoints or certify backend availability.

supplementalStateCoverage.capability: Full combined rank, relay pools and movement pool
supplementalStateCoverage.evidence: state:pool, state:yierList, state:lianbanList, state:abMove native pools were added. Own yierAsOf/lianbanAsOf labels are used for relay data; static code reviewed, not certified against a live account.
Drawer evidence accepts row.items and exposes full stock record in native details.

supplementalStateCoverage.capability: Original review shortcut filters and theme grouping
supplementalStateCoverage.evidence: Native generic evidence and stock drawer replace exact original all/top10/p60/hard/seal/theme controls. Native paged show-more controls expose all source rows; exact historical shortcut presentation is intentionally redesigned.

Native diagnostics exposes taskState, staleState, poolBasis, needRule, empSkip, ztPreRules, trendScanProg and related state evidence. These diagnostic fields remain explicit advanced evidence rather than default card content.
